description: This file defines a React component for a Journals page, which displays journal entries and provides a form to create new entries. It manages state, fetches data from an API, and handles form validation and submission.

methods.name: validateJournal
methods.description: Validates a Journal object, ensuring 'date' is present and valid, and 'description' does not exceed 200 characters.

methods.name: JournalsPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering journal entries and form for creating new journals.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches journal entries from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new journal entry via API call.
